CORAM:HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA  AGARWAL  and  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRANAV TRIVEDI  Date : 09/07/2024  ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA AGARWAL) [1] The petitioner essentially is aggrieved by the Award dated 24.06.2020 passed by the Collector under Section 23 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as the Act, 2013), wherein while computing the rehabilitation compensation, the idle time payment to the workers of the petitioners' factory, has been reduced from four months to one month.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The contention of the learned counsel for the Satyendra Packaging Ltd vs Deputy Collector Anand on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52900868/
1 petitioner is NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/9898/2024 ORDER DATED: 09/07/2024 undefined that the Rehabilitation Committee constituted for this purpose has recommended for payment of four months salary to the workers as payment during idle time, as part of the rehabilitation compensation to the petitioner, for the reason that manufacturing plant of the petitioner had to be shifted on account of acquisition of the land in question.

sentences.text: [2] The contention is that the petitioners have written several letters to the Collector to make necessary corrections in the Award however, the Collector had arbitrarily rejected the request and made a baseless counter demand of Rs.89,29,065/- from the petitioners on the plea that the petitioners have caused delay in handing over possession of the site in question to the acquiring body namely National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited.

entities.text: National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: [3] Be that as it may, the issues raised in the present petition are about the computation made under the Award passed under Section 23 of the Act, 2013.
Remedy to the petitioner lies under Section 64 of the Act, 2013, to raise the dispute with regard to rehabilitation and resettlement award, the compensation payable to the workers for idle time.

[4] As regards the dispute raised by the petitioner with respect to the demand raised by the Collector about delay, the said issue may also be raised before the authority while making reference under Section 64, inasmuch as, the issue with respect to the date of delivery of possession by the petitioner would require a NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/9898/2024 ORDER DATED: 09/07/2024 undefined factual inquiry.

[5] In view of the above, we dispose of the instant petition with the observation that the petitioners shall invoke proceedings under Section 64 by making an application for reference before the Collector, who shall deal with the same, strictly in accordance with law.
